Custom proto and sql sqlite

Generated CRUD services next to a hand-written service, from one set of generated types

Sensor SensorService — generated from ent/schema/sensor.go

Reading ReadingService — generated from ent/schema/reading.go

Sensor Analytics SensorAnalyticsService — hand-written custom.proto over custom.sql, no DSL involved

What's happening:
Every button calls the Go server through Connect-Web using the TypeScript types in ent/gen/ts. The yellow section is the hand-written service: its client comes from custom_pb.ts, yet it returns the same Sensor message as the generated CRUD service — including the permissions.Virtual latest_value field, which has no column and is filled from the custom JOIN.
